newsitem.title: GREECE: NATIONAL MORTGAGE BANK AIDS FLOOD VICTIMS.
newsitem.headline: NATIONAL MORTGAGE BANK AIDS FLOOD VICTIMS.

text.p: National Mortgage Bank will support flood victims of Korinthia and Fthiotida prefectures by treating their loan terms more favourably, it said in a statement.
Starting January 15, the bank will suspend all legal action to collect past due loans that were previously granted to flood victims in the two areas.
The bank also decided to lower the penalty interest rate it charges on past due loan payments down to the current going rate until year-end.
Flood victims will also be provided with the option to settle their loan payments by providing down payments of 10 percent.
These favourable measures are valid for loans which fall under presidential decree 137/95. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
